items.raw_excerpt: Aboriginal organisations in north-east Arnhem Land say they have been left to deal with the aftermath of a stolen wages class action that failed to include hundreds of potentially eligible claimants. One Yolŋu elder says he only found out about the class action after others received payments.

items.raw_excerpt: Este 30 de agosto, el proceso de diálogo y consulta también se realiza en San Mateo del Mar y Huamelula, Oaxaca; Cuetzalan del Progreso, Puebla; así como en Orizaba y Cuitláhuac, Veracruz.
